resources.string:
Keep the ball out of your own edge and send it past everyone else.

Put a thumb anywhere on your side of the court and slide: your paddle follows. Every player has their own finger, so everybody can play at the same time. You can also hold the two arrow buttons beside your name, or play with one switch (set in the setup): the paddle follows the ball by itself and the switch changes the angle of your return.

Hit the ball with the end of the paddle to send it sideways. A moving paddle puts spin on the ball so it curves. The ball speeds up with every return.

In a points match, each ball that gets past an opponent scores for you (with two players) or for the last player who touched it. In a lives match, every ball that gets past you costs a life; at zero your edge becomes a wall and the last paddle standing wins.

Power-ups, when switched on: a wide paddle for the player who collected it, a slower ball for everyone, or extra balls. The Relaxed assist makes the ball slower and the paddles wider.

This game is for people on the same screen. There is no Nearby or Online mode yet.
